subtopics.label: Kidney Transplant Immunology and Rejection Monitoring
subtopics.description: Research on immune-mediated rejection mechanisms in kidney allografts, including T-cell and antibody-mediated rejection, urinary cell mRNA and RNA-sequencing biomarkers for noninvasive rejection diagnosis, donor-derived cell-free DNA, and transcriptomic profiling of allograft status.
subtopics.short_description: T-cell and antibody-mediated rejection mechanisms, urinary biomarkers, and transcriptomic profiling of kidney allograft status.

subtopics.label: Kidney Transplant Outcomes, Management, and Complications
subtopics.description: Clinical studies examining outcomes of kidney transplantation including allograft failure transitions, dialysis nonadherence effects, BK virus nephropathy, COVID-19 in transplant recipients, HIV-infected recipients, frailty assessment, robotic surgical techniques, and post-transplant infection management.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical outcomes of kidney transplantation including allograft failure, BK virus nephropathy, frailty, and post-transplant infection management.

subtopics.label: Autosomal Dominant Polycystic Kidney Disease: Imaging and Disease Monitoring
subtopics.description: Studies focused on MRI-based measurement and deep learning segmentation of kidney and liver volumes in ADPKD, including quantitative susceptibility mapping, hemorrhagic cyst biomarkers, pericardial and pleural effusions, pancreatic cysts, spinal meningeal diverticula, and IVC compression as disease manifestations.
subtopics.short_description: MRI-based kidney and liver volume measurement, deep learning segmentation, and systemic manifestations in polycystic kidney disease.

subtopics.label: CKD Progression: Molecular Mechanisms and Fibrosis
subtopics.description: Research into molecular and cellular mechanisms driving chronic kidney disease progression and fibrosis, including TGF-β1 signaling, mitofusin-2 in macrophages, retinoic acid receptor activity in proximal tubules, iron therapy effects on macrophages, erythropoietin production, and profibrotic gene expression in interstitial cells.
subtopics.short_description: Cellular and molecular drivers of chronic kidney disease progression, including TGF-β1 signaling, macrophage biology, and profibrotic gene expression.

subtopics.label: ENaC, Electrolyte Transport, and Renal Ion Homeostasis
subtopics.description: Mechanistic studies of epithelial sodium channel (ENaC) regulation including ubiquitination, cleavage states, aldosterone-dependent trafficking, and the role of ENaC and ROMK in renal sodium and potassium excretion, as well as proximal tubule transport regulation by dietary potassium.
subtopics.short_description: Epithelial sodium channel regulation, aldosterone-dependent trafficking, and proximal tubule sodium and potassium handling.

subtopics.label: CKD Mineral Metabolism, Bone Disease, and FGF23
subtopics.description: Studies examining mineral and bone disorder in chronic kidney disease, including FGF23 and iron interactions, phosphate management in hemodialysis, vitamin D metabolism via intestinal and renal Cyp24a1, iron therapy effects on bone health in children, parathyroidectomy for secondary hyperparathyroidism, and klotho in CKD outcomes.
subtopics.display_name: Mineral Metabolism & Bone Disease in CKD
subtopics.short_description: FGF23, phosphate management, vitamin D metabolism, and skeletal complications in chronic kidney disease.

subtopics.label: Acute Kidney Injury: Epidemiology, Risk Factors, and Critical Care
subtopics.description: Research on acute kidney injury incidence, risk stratification, and management in critical care settings including COVID-19-associated AKI, AKI in MIS-C, AKI prediction using machine learning and federated learning, renal replacement therapy on ECMO, peritoneal dialysis catheter placement, and hydronephrosis risk stratification.
subtopics.display_name: Acute Kidney Injury in Critical Care
subtopics.short_description: AKI incidence, risk stratification, machine learning prediction, and renal replacement therapy in critically ill patients.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Chronic Kidney Disease: Growth, Anemia, and Complications
subtopics.description: Studies on chronic kidney disease in children and adolescents, including growth impairment, delayed menarche, anemia management with iron therapy, TNF-α and mineral bone disorder, pubertal LH levels and GFR decline, and longitudinal outcomes in the CKiD cohort.
subtopics.short_description: Growth impairment, anemia, pubertal development, and longitudinal outcomes in children with chronic kidney disease.

subtopics.label: Hemodialysis: Access, Complications, and Patient Management
subtopics.description: Clinical research on hemodialysis including arteriovenous fistula stenosis detection, mechanical thrombectomy for thrombosed access, emergency department utilization, COVID-19 vaccine hesitancy, pain management with transcranial direct current stimulation, IL-6 inhibition with clazakizumab, HCV screening cost-effectiveness, and phosphate management trials.
subtopics.short_description: Arteriovenous fistula care, thrombectomy, pain management, infection screening, and phosphate control in hemodialysis patients.

subtopics.label: Computational Pathology and AI-Based Renal Image Analysis
subtopics.description: Development and validation of deep learning and computational methods for renal pathological image segmentation, 3D glomerular reconstruction, multi-object tracking on serial whole slide images, and lay annotator-based molecular-empowered learning for kidney pathology.
subtopics.short_description: Deep learning segmentation, 3D glomerular reconstruction, and computational methods for kidney pathology image analysis.

subtopics.label: CKD and Cardiovascular Complications
subtopics.description: Research examining the intersection of chronic kidney disease with cardiovascular outcomes, including pulmonary hypertension screening, cardiac biomarkers and quality of life, plasma serotonin and cardiovascular risk, FGF23-driven cardiac metabolic remodeling, eGFR formulas predicting surgical mortality, and tricuspid regurgitation in CKD with cardiogenic shock.
subtopics.short_description: Pulmonary hypertension, FGF23-driven cardiac remodeling, and cardiovascular risk biomarkers in chronic kidney disease.

subtopics.label: CKD Epidemiology, Awareness, and Clinical Outcomes
subtopics.description: Population-level studies on CKD prevalence, awareness, and outcomes including racial and geographic disparities, CKD in Haiti, HIV-associated CKD in Tanzania, NAFLD-associated CKD, blood pressure targets and mortality, reproductive counseling for women with CKD, and global availability of kidney health tests.
subtopics.short_description: Population-level CKD prevalence, racial and geographic disparities, global awareness, and clinical outcomes across diverse populations.

subtopics.label: Kidney Stones, Hyperparathyroidism, and Mineral Disorders
subtopics.description: Clinical studies on kidney stone recurrence and 24-hour urine collection in high-risk formers, parathyroidectomy outcomes for renal secondary hyperparathyroidism, and atypical hemolytic uremic syndrome treatment decisions.
subtopics.short_description: Stone recurrence prevention, 24-hour urine evaluation, parathyroidectomy outcomes, and atypical hemolytic uremic syndrome management.

subtopics.label: Renal Cell Carcinoma: Molecular Biology and Biomarkers
subtopics.description: Research on the molecular mechanisms and biomarkers of renal cell carcinoma, including ATF4-driven metabolic remodeling in clear cell RCC, Ndufa4l2 and lipid accumulation, genetically engineered mouse models, CA-125 in renal medullary carcinoma, and cfDNA methylome-based detection.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular mechanisms, metabolic remodeling, and biomarkers in renal cell carcinoma, including cfDNA methylome-based detection.

subtopics.label: Electrolyte Disorders: Hyponatremia, Dysnatremia, and Hypophosphatemia
subtopics.description: Clinical studies on electrolyte disturbances in hospitalized patients including inpatient hyponatremia management via e-consults, dysnatremia associations with COVID-19 mortality, hypophosphatemia following ferric carboxymaltose, and MASP2 elevation in thrombotic microangiopathies.
subtopics.short_description: Inpatient management of hyponatremia, dysnatremia in COVID-19, hypophosphatemia after iron therapy, and thrombotic microangiopathies.

subtopics.label: Diabetes and Cardiovascular Outcomes in Cardiac Procedures
subtopics.description: Research examining how diabetes mellitus affects in-hospital and short-term mortality, morbidity, and procedural outcomes in patients undergoing cardiac interventions including STEMI management, aortic valve replacement, aortic aneurysm repair, and aortic dissection surgery.
subtopics.short_description: Impact of diabetes mellitus on mortality and morbidity in patients undergoing STEMI management, valve replacement, and aortic surgery.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Clinical Outcomes, Complications, and Subphenotypes
subtopics.description: Studies characterizing clinical presentations, risk factors, complications (including thrombosis, PRES, and ARDS), and post-acute sequelae of COVID-19 infection, including machine-learning-derived subphenotype identification and post-discharge outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical presentations, thrombosis, ARDS, post-acute sequelae, and machine-learning-derived subphenotypes of COVID-19 infection.

subtopics.label: Hypertension Management, Complications, and Special Populations
subtopics.description: Research on hypertension diagnosis, blood pressure targets, and management across special populations including pregnancy, HIV patients, and emergency settings, as well as complications such as end-organ damage and primary hyperaldosteronism.
subtopics.short_description: Blood pressure targets, end-organ damage, and hypertension care in pregnancy, HIV patients, and emergency settings.

subtopics.label: HIV-Associated Renal, Cardiovascular, and Metabolic Complications
subtopics.description: Studies investigating renal, cardiovascular, and metabolic complications in people living with HIV, including albuminuria, diastolic dysfunction, body composition changes, and inflammatory biomarker associations.
subtopics.short_description: Albuminuria, diastolic dysfunction, body composition changes, and inflammatory biomarkers in people living with HIV.

subtopics.label: Diabetic Microvascular Complications and Risk Factor Control
subtopics.description: Research on the prevalence, risk factors, and prevention of diabetic microvascular complications including neuropathy, retinopathy, and nephropathy, with emphasis on glycemic and blood pressure control targets.
subtopics.short_description: Prevalence, risk factors, and prevention of neuropathy, retinopathy, and nephropathy through glycemic and blood pressure control.

subtopics.label: Kidney Dysfunction in Liver Disease and Cirrhosis
subtopics.description: Studies examining the impact of cirrhosis and liver disease on renal outcomes, including kidney dysfunction types and mortality in hospitalized cirrhosis patients, and outcomes after percutaneous coronary intervention in end-stage liver disease.
subtopics.short_description: Renal outcomes, mortality, and kidney dysfunction types in hospitalized patients with cirrhosis and end-stage liver disease.

subtopics.label: Infectious Complications in Transplant Recipients
subtopics.description: Research on infectious complications following solid organ transplantation, including BK virus nephropathy diagnosis, urinary tract infections, gut microbiota and UTI risk, bacteriophage therapy, and donor-derived malignancies.
subtopics.short_description: BK virus nephropathy, urinary tract infections, gut microbiota, bacteriophage therapy, and donor-derived malignancies in transplant recipients.

subtopics.label: Pregnancy Outcomes and Counseling in Transplant Recipients
subtopics.description: Studies addressing renal function, pregnancy outcomes, and ethical considerations in solid organ transplant recipients, including uterus transplant recipients and post-transplant pregnancy counseling guidelines.
subtopics.short_description: Renal function, pregnancy outcomes, and ethical considerations in solid organ transplant recipients including uterus transplant patients.

subtopics.label: Nephrology Quality Metrics, Payment Models, and Medical Education
subtopics.description: Research on quality measurement and payment reform in nephrology practice, including MIPS performance, value-based care pathways, capitated versus fee-for-service reimbursement, and nephrology medical education innovations.
subtopics.short_description: MIPS performance, value-based care pathways, capitated reimbursement models, and medical education innovations in nephrology practice.

subtopics.label: Pharmacological Therapies and Drug Effects in CKD and Renal Patients
subtopics.description: Studies evaluating specific pharmacological interventions in CKD and renal patients, including intravenous iron formulations, sevelamer-associated GI injury, anti-TNF therapy renal lesions, and perioperative fluid management.
subtopics.short_description: Intravenous iron formulations, sevelamer-associated injury, anti-TNF renal effects, and perioperative fluid management in renal patients.

subtopics.label: Novel Kidney Disease Biomarkers and Genetic Mechanisms
subtopics.description: Research identifying and validating novel biomarkers for kidney disease including proenkephalin-A, IgA glycomics, and APOL1-mediated kidney disease mechanisms and therapeutic targeting.
subtopics.short_description: Proenkephalin-A, IgA glycomics, and APOL1-mediated kidney disease mechanisms and therapeutic targeting.

subtopics.label: Peritoneal Dialysis: Infection Diagnosis and Management
subtopics.description: Studies focused on peritoneal dialysis complications and management, particularly the use of cell-free DNA sequencing for pathogen detection in peritonitis and clinical management of PD patients.
subtopics.short_description: Cell-free DNA sequencing for pathogen detection in peritonitis and clinical management of peritoneal dialysis complications.

subtopics.label: Aortic Surgery and Renal Outcomes
subtopics.description: Research examining renal outcomes and complications in patients undergoing aortic surgery, including the impact of preoperative renal insufficiency on proximal aortic surgery outcomes and AI-assisted radiation reduction in complex aneurysm repair.
subtopics.short_description: Preoperative renal insufficiency effects and AI-assisted radiation reduction in patients undergoing proximal and complex aortic surgery.
